backup_cli.usage.backup:
Creates an encrypted backup. The public key goes in
ESTIA_BACKUP_PUBLIC_KEY, or a passphrase in ESTIA_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE.
backup_cli.usage.footer:
An archive is a tar encrypted with age: it opens without ESTIA too, with
age -d -i key.txt archive.tar.age | tar -xv
backup_cli.usage.keys:
Generates a key pair for backups. The private key is shown only once
and must leave the instance: without it the backups cannot be opened,
and nobody can recover them.
backup_cli.usage.restore:
Restores an archive. The private key is asked for on screen,
or passed in ESTIA_BACKUP_PRIVATE_KEY. With --sovrascrivi it overwrites
the existing data only after the key has been checked.
